'''Nal Kenuun's apartment''' was the home of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Nal Kenuun]] located on one of the tallest buildings in the city of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. The apartment was nearly empty inside, containing only a few pieces of sleek black furniture, appearing nearly invisible against the black walls. [[Transparisteel/Legends|Transparisteel]] windows covered both floor and ceiling, giving a wide view of the Pilaan skyline. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] concluded that the home projected a quiet, careful wealth when he, along with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[X-7]], went there in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="target" />
